DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZE(
			'Asset SOTI License Summary',
			'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Category],
			'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Value]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			501,
			__DS0Core,
			'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Category],
			1,
			'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Value],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Category], 'Asset SOTI License Summary'[Value]

Compose_SOTILic.inputs:
<style>
    /* 1. Force the table to respect strict widths */
    table {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 800px; /* Optional: Stops it from getting too wide on big screens */
        border: 1px solid #b3adad;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        table-layout: fixed; /* <--- THIS IS THE KEY FIX */
        font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* 2. Styling for Headers */
    table th {
        border: 1px solid #b3adad;
        background-color: #FFCC00; 
        color: #d40511;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 8px;
        text-align: center;
        overflow: hidden; /* Prevents long text from breaking layout */
    }

    /* 3. Styling for Rows */
    table td {
        border: 1px solid #b3adad;
        text-align: center;
        background-color: #ffffff;
        color: #313030;
        padding: 8px;
        word-wrap: break-word; /* Forces long text to wrap to next line */
    }

    /* 4. DEFINE COLUMN WIDTHS 
       This forces the first column to ALWAYS be 60% and second 40%, 
       regardless of how much text is inside. */
    table th:first-child, table td:first-child {
        width: 65%;
    }
    table th:last-child, table td:last-child {
        width: 35%;
    }
</style>@{body('Create_HTML_table_SOTIic')}
